name: Nizhnevartovsk

queries.query: Nizhnevartovsk cadastral parcel map official land registry GIS parcels
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official City 3D geoportal and its published EGRN land-plot layers. The viewer description says the layers show land-plot boundaries from the Unified State Register of Real Estate. No anonymous polygon response was verified.

queries.query: Нижневартовск публичная кадастровая карта кадастровые кварталы официальный Росреестр
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official municipal 3D geoportal, EGRN land-plot layers, and the municipal land-plot open-data API documentation. Viewer configuration exposed a historical GeoServer/WFS layer for parcel search, but bounded anonymous requests returned HTTP 404.

registryEvidence.custodian: Administration of Nizhnevartovsk / municipal digital territorial-development geoportal; Rosreestr EGRN is the stated source of the displayed land plots
registryEvidence.locality: Nizhnevartovsk, Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug-Yugra, Russian Federation
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The municipal portal is evidence of a local public map/custodian and of displayed EGRN-derived land-plot layers; it is not evidence that an open reusable citywide parcel API is available. Rosreestr is recorded as the upstream national register, not as a successfully queried endpoint in this attempt.

parcelDiscovery.note: The portal HTML configuration exposed GeoServer layer User_2:loc2634607873808485038 with WFS URL https://geoportal.n-vartovsk.ru/User_2/ows and a polygon style, plus EGRN KML layers. No full KML was downloaded because the configured files are large (approximately 106 MB and 352 MB).

requests.assessment: Official municipal 3D geoportal landing page; describes EGRN land-plot boundaries.
Official viewer page; inline ROOT_LOCATION configuration exposed EGRN layers 1075 and 1107 and historical WFS search layer 587.
Configured WFS route returned the portal's 404 page; no capabilities or schema response.
Bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry request, capped at three features and using a small box around the exact WUP point; returned 404, not evidence of citywide absence.
Official municipal open-data API documentation route; response states that API_KEY is required. No key was used or sought.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal Nizhnevartovsk 3D portal displays EGRN-derived land-plot layers covering mapped portal extents.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No open parcel geometry response verified in this attempt.

remainingUncertainty: The portal exposes large EGRN KML layer files and a historical WFS configuration, but no bounded anonymous response was available from the tested route.
The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; a 404 or map/API access failure is not evidence of parcel absence.
Native stable parcel identity and CRS remain unverified because no feature response was returned.
No unsafe owner, address/contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, or other sensitive fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission; serial runtime qualification remains required.
nextStep: A serial reviewer should independently recheck the current municipal viewer's network routes and qualify any bounded ID-plus-geometry response before adapter work.
